note: Both sets extract the same nine claims and share the same keynote-to-beam misbindings: A1 and A4 are swapped (FLOOR BEAM @ GRID 6 is A1, FLOOR BEAM @ GRID 2 is A4), and B1 and B4 are swapped (FLOOR BEAM NEAR GRID 5 is B1, FLOOR BEAM @ GRID 3 is B4). remarks: The keynote letters in the text layer are paired with the wrong descriptions in both extractions (A1/A4 and B1/B4 swapped), suggesting a systematic row-alignment issue in the extraction pipeline rather than random error. 'T.O. STEEL' is part of the E6 description label, not a condition on the section claim.
